Напиши код парсинга HTML через BeautifulSoup на Python.

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
def get_titles(url):
    r = requests.get(url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(r.text, 'html.parser')
    return [h1.text.strip() for h1 in soup.find_all('h1')]
